Concept2 Model D at the West End YMCA, back row by the window. Damper on 4, drag factor 118 (the guy before me always leaves it on 10, change it). Favourite session: 8 × 500 m with 1:30 rest, target 2:14/500 m split, stroke rate 24 to 26. Best so far 2025-01-29: avg split 2:11.6, last rep 2:08.9, HR peaked 172. Also 30 min steady at 2:28 when the treadmills are full. Legs, then body, then arms on the drive; arms, body, legs on the recovery. On swing days I sometimes stack it after [[Kettlebell swings]], and in winter it rotates with [[Cycling FTP test]] workouts.
